first_sentence: 這是麵包！因為酵母吐氣，麵團就變大。
facts: 酵母是很小很小的微生物

烤的時候，氣體受熱會再膨脹

en.first_sentence: This is bread! Tiny bugs breathe out gas, so dough gets bigger.
facts: Yeast is a tiny living bug that lives in the dough.
The bugs eat sugar in the flour and breathe out a gas.
When the bread bakes, the gas gets hot and puffs up more.
en.ask_back: Do you think bread would get bigger in a cold room, or a warm room?

bridges.has_dog: When dogs smell bread, do they wag their tails?
